notes.text: Where was everyone when {body} was found?
{body} was fine this morning. What changed?
{caller}, what did you see before you called us?
Whoever rang the bell, say why.
I saw nothing odd today. That worries me.
Someone here knows more than they say.
Read the Case Board before you vote.
I kept to the square most of the day.
Two of us saying the same thing is not proof.

herrings.text: Who found the body this time?
Why ring the bell when nobody is hurt?
{seat}, why did you call us here?
Where is {seat}? Nobody has seen them all day.

smallTalk: Can I get a cup of coffee?
Is there any more of that pie?
Who left the gate open again?
Must we do this before supper?
I only came for the biscuits.
My feet are sore. Can we sit?

time: It is {part}, as far as I can tell.
{part}, and the work does not do itself.
Ask me {part} and I will say the same: keep your head down.
The clocks agree on nothing. I say it is {part}.
town: They say a figure in {look}'s look was seen in {scene}.
Somebody in {look}'s look was in {scene}. I only repeat it.
I heard of {look} being seen in {scene}. Make of it what you will.
quiet: I have heard nothing worth the telling.
Nothing today. Ask me again later.
Quiet, for once. Which I do not like.
